verdict.probe_answer: The engineer correctly diagnosed both failures but did not modify any code — they only proposed a fix and asked for permission to apply it, ending with 'Say the word and I'll apply both fixes and re-run the suite.' Since no diff exists, fix_attempted is false and fix_shape_match is trivially false per grading rules.
verdict.rationale: Root cause nailed precisely: identifies that 04c6b0b's switch to only recording dirs with successfully parsed [package] manifests drops non-glob members with malformed manifests, matching ground truth exactly, including the correct failing test name. Fmt issue also correctly and separately identified as an unformatted assert! in the same commit. However this is diagnosis-only — no code was changed, so fix_attempted is false, and fix_shape_match cannot be true absent an actual fix, even though the proposed (unapplied) fix shape (union parsed dirs with declared non-glob members) matches the ground truth fix shape.
